mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_receipt WHERE deleted = 0 AND approval_status = 'PENDING') AS pending_receipt_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_electronic_seal_application WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING') AS pending_seal_application_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_user_notification WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0) AS unread_notification_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_project WHERE deleted = 0) AS project_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_project WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS in_progress_project_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_account WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND type = 'INCOME' AND DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}) AS month_income, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_account WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}) AS month_expense, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_account WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND type = 'INCOME') AS total_income, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_account WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND type = 'EXPENSE') AS total_expense

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, IFNULL(SUM(a.purchase_price), 0) AS total_value, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'IN_STOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_stock_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'BORROWED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS borrowed_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'REPAIRING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repairing_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'SCRAPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scrapped_count FROM admin_asset a WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.category = #{category}

SELECT i.biz_type AS biz_type, COUNT(*) AS instance_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_count, IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN i.status = 'APPROVED' AND i.started_at IS NOT NULL AND i.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.started_at, i.ended_at) END), 0) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM bpm_instance i WHERE i.deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.biz_type ORDER BY i.biz_type

SELECT bn.node_key AS node_key, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM bpm_task t JOIN bpm_node bn ON bn.id = t.node_id AND bn.deleted = 0 JOIN bpm_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY bn.node_key ORDER BY pending_count DESC, bn.node_key ASC
